title: Edit Drafts Faster With ChatGPT Canvas

beats: Editing long drafts in ChatGPT is slow and repetitive.
Regenerating everything just to fix one part wastes your time.
Open Canvas next to your chat window.
Canvas loads your writing or code in a side-by-side editor.
You can now see your full draft while you work.
Highlight the exact section you want to change in Canvas.
Type your instruction for ChatGPT to focus on only that part.
Avoid unnecessary changes to the rest of your draft.

lines.t: Highlight: The introduction needs a friendlier tone.
Rewrite this section to sound friendly.

beats: ChatGPT edits just the highlighted section as you asked.
The rest of your document stays untouched.
Use Canvas to edit, rewrite, or review long drafts without starting over.
Follow for a new AI tutorial every day.
